query:
SELECT
             COALESCE(dt.value->'database'->>'resource_type', 'unknown') AS "kind!",
             COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count!"
           FROM workspace_settings ws,
                LATERAL jsonb_each(ws.datatable->'datatables') dt
           WHERE jsonb_typeof(ws.datatable->'datatables') = 'object'
           GROUP BY 1
